objective: Evolve existing MoonWitness XV packages and 12 active ORM addon domains into one consistent, ultra-complete anime/grunge visual universe with canonical assets, production pipeline, optional scene runtime, creative lab, UI/domain coverage, quality gates and one immersive homepage vertical slice.
principles: reuse existing packages and addon manifests
one canonical asset inventory and provenance system
static artwork is not an ORM migration or DB seed
small atomic tasks with explicit dependencies
all generated assets are reviewable and licensed
accessibility, reduced motion and performance are first-class
no fictional production data or unsupported routes
no fake completion or endless retry loops

execution_policy.completion_rule: A task is done only when all acceptance criteria pass and concrete evidence is recorded. A commit alone is not proof.
stop_conditions: stop after two failed attempts on the same task and mark blocked with logs
stop before paid/proprietary engine purchase or license acceptance
stop when branch protection or missing credentials prevent authorized push
do not loop repeatedly on the same failed gate
continue independent tasks when a task is blocked
execution_policy.parallelization: Parallelize only tasks with disjoint files and satisfied dependencies. Freeze manifest/scene contracts before parallel implementers. One writer per shared manifest, lockfile, token file, or global CSS file.
execution_policy.branch_policy: Start on latest dev. Do not create unnecessary branches. Never force push, bypass protection or push to main/master. If dev rejects direct push, use the repo-approved PR workflow only when permitted; otherwise stop and report.
execution_policy.issue_policy: Do not create duplicate GitHub issues or milestones. Update existing task documentation and evidence; create issues only if the user/repo workflow explicitly requires it.
execution_policy.no_overengineering: Do not add Rive, Live2D, GSAP, Pixi, Three.js, WebGL, animation frameworks or new packages by default. Prove need, licensing, bundle cost and at least two consumers first.
execution_policy.evidence_policy: Record command, exit code, relevant output/artifact path, commit SHA and any visual reviewer decision. Never report a command as run if it was not run.
